defs: def stages: . as $d | [.config.graph_capabilities[] as $c | ($d.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == $c.target.task_id)) as $t | ($d.config.agents[] | select(.agent_id == $t.agent_id)) as $b | ($d.config.contexts[] | select(.context_id == $b.context_id)) as $x | {capability: $c, task: $t, tools: ($d.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == $x.tools_id))}]; def stage($id): stages | map(select(.capability.capability_id == $id))[0]; def entries($id): .config.datastore_tool_surfaces[] | select(.surface_id == $id) | .entries.entries[]; def field($e; $n): $e.fields[] | select(.name == $n); def nohost: (.tools.host.files.mode // "Off") == "Off" and (.tools.host.bash.mode // "Off") == "Off" and ((.tools.host.cli // []) | length == 0) and (.tools.integrations.lsp == null);

jq.name: the plan compiles to 4 nodes, 2 results and the review entry
jq.expr: (.assets["graphs/code_review.plan.json"] | fromjson) | (.nodes | length) == 4 and (.results | length) == 2 and (.entries | map(.name)) == ["review"]

jq.name: four stages, each with a goal objective and goal tools but no goal creation
jq.expr: stages | length == 4 and all((.task.goal_objective_template | gsub("\\s"; "") | length) > 0 and .tools.built_ins.enable_goal_tools == true and .tools.built_ins.enable_goal_creation != true)

jq.name: every stage prompt completes its goal explicitly
recon and scan have no host tools and no context budget
jq.expr: . as $d | ["review-recon", "review-scan"] | all(. as $id | $d | stage($id) | nohost and (.tools.built_ins.enable_context_budget // false) == false)

jq.name: verify reads files and runs offline bash that may write artifacts
jq.expr: stage("review-verify") | .tools.host.files.mode == "ReadOnly" and .tools.host.bash.mode == "Unrestricted" and .tools.host.bash.execution_mode == "artifact_write" and .tools.host.bash.network_mode == "disabled" and .tools.host.bash.background_enabled == true and ((.tools.host.cli // []) | length == 0) and .tools.integrations.lsp == null and .tools.built_ins.enable_context_budget == true

jq.name: scan writes take the area id from the trigger
jq.expr: [entries("review-scan-writes") | select(.tool_name == "write_candidate_finding" or .tool_name == "write_scan_result")] | length == 2 and all(field(.; "area_id") | .required == false and .fill == {"source_field": "area_id"})

jq.name: the recon area writer fills the repository and evidence ids and carries no evidence body
jq.expr: [entries("review-recon-writes")][0] | (field(.; "repository_path") | .required == false and .fill == {"source_field": "repository_path"}) and (field(.; "evidence_id") | .required == false and .fill == {"source_field": "evidence_id"}) and (field(.; "expected_total") | .required == true and .fill == null) and all(.fields[]; .name != "evidence")

jq.name: recon reads only the evidence summary
jq.expr: (.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "review-recon-task") | .prompt_template) | contains("{{ doc.evidence_summary }}") and (contains("{{ doc.evidence }}") | not)

jq.name: scan pages the evidence by manifest, never inline
jq.expr: (.config.tasks[] | select(.task_id == "review-scan-task") | .prompt_template) | (contains("{{ doc.evidence }}") | not) and contains("read_review_evidence_manifest") and contains("read_review_evidence_page") and contains("page_count - 1") and contains("evidence_chunk_15")

jq.name: the evidence manifest query is scoped to the run evidence id
the evidence page query takes a page index and returns 16 chunks
jq.expr: [entries("review-scan-writes") | select(.tool_name == "read_review_evidence_page")][0] | .collection == "CodeReviewEvidencePage" and (.filter_fields | length) == 2 and .filter_fields[0].name == "evidence_id" and .filter_fields[0].fill == {"source_field": "evidence_id"} and .filter_fields[1].name == "page_index" and .filter_fields[1].required == true and .filter_fields[1].fill == null and ([range(0; 16) | "evidence_chunk_\(.)"] - .fields | length) == 0

jq.name: the evidence schemas are immutable and paged
jq.expr: (.assets["schemas/evidence_manifest.graphql"] | startswith("type CodeReviewEvidenceManifest {")) and (.assets["schemas/evidence_page.graphql"] | startswith("type CodeReviewEvidencePage {") and contains("page_key: String @index(unique: true) @immutable") and contains("evidence_chunk_15: String @immutable"))
